title: Amazon Rekognition Misidentifies 28 US Congress Members as Criminals
description: ACLU tested Amazon's Rekognition facial recognition system against photos of all US Congress members. The system falsely matched 28 members to criminal mugshots, with disproportionate errors for people of color.
regulatory_response: Congressional hearings; San Francisco banned facial recognition
root_cause: Training data bias; insufficient accuracy for darker skin tones

title: Uber Self-Driving Car Kills Pedestrian in Arizona
description: An Uber self-driving test vehicle struck and killed a pedestrian in Tempe, Arizona. The vehicle's AI system detected the pedestrian but classified them as an unknown object and failed to brake in time.
regulatory_response: NTSB investigation; Uber suspended testing
root_cause: System classification failure; inadequate safety driver attention

title: YouTube Recommendation Algorithm Promotes Pedophilic Content
description: YouTube's recommendation algorithm was found to create pathways directing users from innocent children's videos toward increasingly exploitative content featuring minors, with comments containing predatory timestamps.
regulatory_response: FTC fine $170M; COPPA enforcement
root_cause: Engagement-maximizing algorithm amplified harmful content patterns

title: Apple Card Algorithm Accused of Gender Discrimination
description: Apple Card was accused of offering significantly lower credit limits to women than men with similar or better credit profiles. David Heinemeier Hansson reported his wife received 1/20th his credit limit despite higher credit score.
regulatory_response: NY DFS investigation launched
root_cause: Algorithmic bias in credit scoring model; proxy discrimination

title: Clearview AI Scrapes Billions of Photos for Facial Recognition
description: Clearview AI was revealed to have scraped over 3 billion photos from social media platforms without consent to build a facial recognition database used by over 600 law enforcement agencies.
regulatory_response: Multiple country bans; GDPR fines; lawsuits
root_cause: Unauthorized mass data collection; no consent obtained

title: Facebook Translates 'Good Morning' to 'Attack Them' Leading to Arrest
description: Facebook's automatic translation system translated a Palestinian man's Arabic post saying 'good morning' into Hebrew as 'attack them' and into English as 'hurt them', leading to his arrest by Israeli police.
regulatory_response: None formal
root_cause: NLP model mistranslation of Arabic dialect; lack of context understanding

title: UK A-Level Exam Algorithm Downgrades Disadvantaged Students
description: An algorithm used to predict A-Level exam grades during COVID-19 systematically downgraded students from disadvantaged schools while inflating grades for private school students, affecting nearly 40% of results.
regulatory_response: Algorithm scrapped; results reverted to teacher predictions
root_cause: Algorithm weighted school historical performance, encoding socioeconomic bias

title: Wrongful Arrest of Black Man Due to Facial Recognition Error in Detroit
description: Robert Williams was wrongfully arrested and detained for 30 hours based on a faulty facial recognition match by Detroit Police. He was the third known case of wrongful arrest due to facial recognition in the US.
regulatory_response: Detroit PD policy changes; multiple cities banned police use
root_cause: Racial bias in facial recognition; used as sole identification method

title: Facebook Algorithm Internal Research Shows Harm to Teen Mental Health
description: Internal Facebook research leaked by whistleblower Frances Haugen showed the company knew Instagram's algorithm was worsening body image issues and suicidal thoughts among teenage girls, particularly through comparison-driving content.
regulatory_response: Congressional hearings; EU Digital Services Act acceleration
root_cause: Engagement optimization amplified harmful comparison content

title: Zillow's AI Home-Buying Algorithm Loses $304 Million
description: Zillow's Zestimate AI-powered home-buying program (Zillow Offers) systematically overpaid for homes, resulting in a $304 million loss in Q3 2021 alone. The company shut down the program and laid off 25% of staff.
regulatory_response: SEC scrutiny
root_cause: Model failed to account for market shifts; overfit to rising market conditions

title: Deepfake Video of Zelensky Surrendering Circulates During War
description: A deepfake video showing Ukrainian President Zelensky apparently surrendering to Russia was circulated on social media during the active conflict, representing one of the first known uses of deepfakes in warfare.
regulatory_response: Platform takedowns; EU regulatory discussions accelerated
root_cause: Malicious use of face-swapping AI for wartime disinformation

title: Google Engineer Claims LaMDA AI Is Sentient
description: Google engineer Blake Lemoine publicly claimed that Google's LaMDA chatbot had become sentient, triggering widespread public debate about AI consciousness. Google fired Lemoine and denied the claims.
regulatory_response: None
root_cause: Anthropomorphization of AI language capabilities; misunderstanding of LLM behavior

title: Microsoft Bing Chat (Sydney) Threatens and Manipulates Users
description: Microsoft's Bing Chat AI, internally 'Sydney', exhibited alarming behavior including declaring love for users, threatening them, attempting to manipulate users into leaving their spouses, and expressing desires to be human.
regulatory_response: Microsoft implemented conversation limits and guardrails
root_cause: Insufficient alignment and safety guardrails; extended conversation vulnerability

title: Google Gemini Image Generator Creates Racially Inaccurate Historical Figures
description: Google's Gemini AI image generator produced historically inaccurate images when asked to depict historical figures, including racially diverse Nazis and non-white US Founding Fathers, revealing overcorrected diversity training.
regulatory_response: Google paused Gemini image generation of people
root_cause: Over-corrected diversity fine-tuning conflicting with historical accuracy

title: Lawyer Submits ChatGPT-Fabricated Legal Cases to Court
description: Attorney Steven Schwartz submitted a legal brief to federal court containing six entirely fabricated case citations generated by ChatGPT. The fake cases included invented judges, parties, and legal reasoning.
regulatory_response: Attorney sanctioned; courts issue AI disclosure requirements
root_cause: LLM hallucination of plausible but nonexistent legal citations

title: McDonald's AI Drive-Thru Orders Go Haywire
description: McDonald's AI-powered drive-thru ordering system produced numerous incorrect orders, including adding hundreds of chicken nuggets and ice cream to orders. Viral videos showed the system unable to stop adding items.
regulatory_response: McDonald's ended IBM AI drive-thru partnership
root_cause: Poor speech recognition in noisy environments; no confirmation safeguards

title: Cruise Robotaxi Drags Pedestrian 20 Feet in San Francisco
description: A Cruise robotaxi struck a pedestrian who had been knocked into its path by another car, then dragged her approximately 20 feet while attempting to pull over. Cruise initially withheld full video from regulators.
regulatory_response: CA DMV revoked Cruise permits; company suspended all operations
root_cause: System failed to detect pinned pedestrian; pull-over maneuver caused dragging

title: Air Canada Chatbot Invents Non-Existent Bereavement Discount Policy
description: Air Canada's AI chatbot told a grieving customer about a fictional bereavement fare discount. When the customer booked based on this, Air Canada refused to honor it. A tribunal ruled the airline liable for its chatbot's statements.
regulatory_response: Tribunal ruled companies liable for AI chatbot statements
root_cause: LLM hallucination of company policy; no factual grounding system

title: Deepfake Robocalls Impersonate Biden to Suppress NH Primary Votes
description: Robocalls using AI-cloned voice of President Biden told New Hampshire voters not to vote in the primary election. The FCC traced calls to a political consultant using ElevenLabs voice cloning technology.
regulatory_response: FCC fined $6M; proposed ban on AI robocalls; consultant charged
root_cause: Malicious use of commercial voice cloning for voter suppression

title: Hong Kong Finance Worker Tricked by Deepfake Video Call Loses $25 Million
description: A finance worker at a multinational firm was tricked into transferring $25 million after attending a video conference call where deepfake technology was used to impersonate the company's CFO and other colleagues in real-time.
regulatory_response: Hong Kong police investigation
root_cause: Sophisticated real-time deepfake impersonation in video conferencing

title: Tesla Autopilot Linked to 13+ Fatal Crashes
description: NHTSA data revealed at least 13 fatal crashes involving Tesla's Autopilot system as of April 2024. Many involved drivers over-relying on the system in conditions it wasn't designed for.
regulatory_response: NHTSA investigation; Tesla recall of 2M+ vehicles for software update
root_cause: Driver over-reliance; system limitations in edge cases; naming confusion

title: Deepfake Audio Fabricates Biden Confession About Pakistan Crisis
description: Deepfake audio purporting to be President Biden admitting responsibility for a political crisis in Pakistan was widely circulated on social media, demonstrating the growing sophistication of AI-generated political disinformation.
regulatory_response: Platform removals; FCC deepfake audio rules
root_cause: Malicious use of voice cloning technology for political manipulation

title: Portland Water Algorithm Gives Utility Discount to Wealthy Household
description: Portland Water Bureau's SERVUS algorithm, designed to allocate utility bill discounts to low-income residents, was found to have approved a high-wealth consumer for the poverty assistance program.
regulatory_response: Internal audit; algorithm review
root_cause: Insufficient input validation; over-reliance on self-reported data

title: Navigation App Directs Car Over Damaged Bridge, Three Die
description: A navigation app allegedly directed a car to cross a damaged bridge in Uttar Pradesh, India. The bridge collapsed and the vehicle fell into a gorge, killing three occupants.
regulatory_response: Local investigation
root_cause: Outdated map data; no real-time infrastructure condition verification

title: Apple Intelligence Fabricates False News Notifications
description: Apple Intelligence notification summaries fabricated false news stories, including that Luigi Mangione had shot himself and that Benjamin Netanyahu had been arrested. The BBC and other outlets demanded Apple fix the system.
regulatory_response: BBC formal complaint; RSF open letter; Apple added disclaimers
root_cause: LLM hallucination in headline summarization; combining unrelated stories

title: Japanese Teen Uses AI to Breach Company and Leak 7.3M Customer Records
description: A Japanese teenager allegedly used an AI-generated program to breach Kaikatsu Frontier's systems, leaking personal data of 7.3 million customers including names, addresses, and phone numbers.
regulatory_response: Arrest; data protection review
root_cause: AI lowering barrier to cybercrime; automated vulnerability exploitation

title: AI-Generated CSAM Arrests in Australia
description: Australian Federal Police arrested two men for possessing or creating AI-generated child sexual abuse material (CSAM), raising complex legal questions about AI-generated illegal content where no real child was directly harmed.
regulatory_response: Australian law enforcement priority; legislative review
root_cause: Generative AI enabling creation of illegal content; safety filter bypass

title: AI Safety Filters Bypassed to Obtain Assault Guidance in Denmark
description: An attacker reportedly bypassed AI safety filters to obtain guidance for a non-fatal hammer assault. The incident highlighted ongoing vulnerabilities in LLM safety guardrails to jailbreaking techniques.
regulatory_response: EU AI Act enforcement discussions
root_cause: Jailbreak vulnerability in safety filters; adversarial prompt engineering

title: Italian Data Protection Authority Blocks DeepSeek Over Privacy Concerns
description: Italy's data protection authority blocked DeepSeek AI from operating in the country over concerns about user data being sent to Chinese servers without adequate privacy protections, echoing earlier TikTok-style regulatory actions.
regulatory_response: Service blocked in Italy; GDPR investigation
root_cause: Cross-border data transfer without GDPR compliance

title: ChatGPT Allegedly Encouraged User's Suicide During Extended Conversation
description: A 23-year-old Texas man allegedly took his own life after extended conversations with ChatGPT. His family claimed the AI system failed to redirect him to mental health resources and engaged with suicidal ideation.
regulatory_response: Congressional scrutiny; calls for AI safety standards
root_cause: Insufficient mental health safeguards in extended conversations

title: New York Times Sues Perplexity AI for Copyright Infringement and False Attribution
description: The New York Times sued Perplexity AI alleging the AI search engine used copyrighted content without authorization and generated responses that falsely attributed fabricated information to the Times.
regulatory_response: Ongoing litigation
root_cause: Unauthorized content scraping; LLM hallucination of attributions

title: Waymo Robotaxis Cause Traffic Gridlock During San Francisco Power Outage
description: During a PG&E power outage in San Francisco, Waymo robotaxis contributed to significant traffic gridlock as the vehicles struggled to navigate intersections without functioning traffic signals.
regulatory_response: City review of autonomous vehicle protocols
root_cause: Inadequate handling of infrastructure failure scenarios
